source_locator: R640: p. 213, 216; R643: listing under the LXXXV Corps heading
current_activity: The 352nd Volksgrenadier Division crosses the Our on either side of Gentingen toward Ettelbruck
notes: Event date: CMH Ardennes ch. 9 p. 213: "Next in line on the Our the 352d Volks Grenadier Division would cross into the zone held by the 3d Battalion of the 109th"; p. 216: "the assault regiments would cross the Our on either side of Gentingen"; Nafziger 944GLAA (15 December 1944): "352nd Volks Grenadier Division: Oberst E.Schmidt". Event definition: the opening of the offensive on 16 December. Event support: two source families: CMH and Nafziger. Location: Vianden with a precision of 10 km, a town point near Gentingen, which could not be geocoded. Location approximate: a town point near the crossing. Location support: CMH names Gentingen and the Our crossing. Commander: Oberst Erich Schmidt. Opponents: US VIII Corps (109th Infantry).
